title: A child with diabetes at school and kindergarten
what: A guide for parents on how to prepare school or kindergarten so a child with diabetes stays safe.
why: Before the start of school, when moving to a new class or kindergarten, and after a change of treatment.
duration: preparing usually takes one or two meetings with the teacher and a medical staff member
tell_doctor: What your child's insulin plan is and how often to check sugar
How your child feels low sugar
Whether a written plan for school is needed, which your doctor can help make

prepare.title: Meeting
prepare.text: Talk to the kindergarten teacher or class teacher, the nurse, and the PE teacher.

prepare.title: Plan
prepare.text: Give a written guide: signs of low and high sugar, what to do, and your phone numbers.

prepare.title: Supplies
prepare.text: Leave fast sugar, a snack, and spare supplies at school.

prepare.title: Your child
prepare.text: Teach your child not to feel shy about saying they feel unwell.

bring: A glucose meter or sensor and spare strips
A school guide with your phone numbers
Insulin and needles, if a shot is needed at school
steps: Tell the adults at school that your child has diabetes
Show what low sugar looks like: paleness, sweating, shaking, crying, strange behavior
Explain that with low sugar, the child is given something sweet right away and is not left alone
Agree who helps with checking sugar and shots, and when
Before PE, your child may need a snack
Agree that they call you at any concern
feel: At first it is scary to let your child go, which is normal
Teachers are often worried too, and the guide calms them
after: Look at the sugar diary for school days
Update the guide if treatment changes
red_flags: Your child is unconscious or having seizures: call emergency services, and give nothing by mouth
Vomiting, severe thirst, or an acetone smell on the breath: see a doctor urgently

faq.q: Can a child with diabetes do PE?
faq.a: Yes, usually. Sugar must be checked before the class and something sweet kept at hand.

faq.q: Can my child eat in class?
faq.a: With low sugar, absolutely. Agree on this with the teacher beforehand.

reminders.text: School tomorrow: check the glucose meter, sweets, snack, and phone charge.
